name: Escape From Somnium
source:
Sigma's vision is shrouded in darkness. 
The room he finds himself in is barely lit, with only the glow of an old CRT monitor piercing through the darkness. Suddenly, a strange man makes his presence known.

"Who the hell [i]are[/i] you?" asks Kaname Date.

[From [url=https://tamafry.itch.io/escape-from-somnium]Itch.io[/url]]

Escape From Somnium is a fan-made AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES x Zero Escape crossover fan game.
